landing.aboutLede: {name} is an AI website studio that works like a production line with checkpoints. The AI drafts requirements, designs, code and documents; {name} makes sure each stage meets its criteria before the next one opens, then checks the result with real security scanners.
aboutAi: Drafts security requirements and data classification
Produces UI designs, architecture, diagrams and database schema
Writes the manual book and the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 mapping report
aboutGate: Locks a stage until all its sub-steps are met, checked on the server
Runs Semgrep and Trivy on the code
Calculates the security score from findings, not estimates
Traces every requirement to its recommendation, file and standard
landing.archLede: Choose a part to read how it works.

archNodes.name: Studio
archNodes.note: Where you work and where every project is stored. (Next.js, PostgreSQL via Prisma.) Access is scoped per account.

archNodes.name: AI provider
archNodes.note: Writes each stage's content with the model you choose. (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Ollama; keys encrypted with AES-256-GCM.) Output quality depends on the chosen model.

archNodes.name: Stage gate
archNodes.note: Checks the criteria before a stage completes. (The server refuses if sub-steps are unmet or an earlier stage is open.) Criteria check that results are complete, not that every line is correct.

archNodes.name: Docker sandbox
archNodes.note: Runs your app in an isolated box. (Node/Next, Python, PHP, Go, static; cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, ports bound to 127.0.0.1, a private network per run.) It reduces the impact of bad code; it does not replace review.

archNodes.name: Scanners
archNodes.note: Checks code and dependencies. (Semgrep for SAST; Trivy for vulnerabilities, secrets and misconfiguration; dependency audit.) It finds known patterns, not every flaw.

archNodes.name: Export & GitHub
archNodes.note: Hands over auditable results. (ZIP, manual book, ISO report, traceability matrix; push and pull requests with a security.yml workflow.) The repository stays yours.

archPlatform: Keys and tokens encrypted with AES-256-GCM
Content Security Policy with a per-request nonce
landing.proofFormula: Score = 100 − (20 × critical + 10 × high + 4 × medium + 1 × low), minimum 0. Only Semgrep and Trivy findings count; a score that comes from the AI is labelled differently.
landing.resultsTitle: What you take home, and what we don't promise.
limits: Not an ISO 27001 or NIST certification; FUSE maps controls and prepares evidence
Scanners find known patterns; human review is still needed
AI output quality depends on the model you choose
Docker is required to run apps and scans

glossary.definition: A software development life cycle with security checks in every stage, not at the end.
NIST's set of secure development practices, grouped PO, PS, PW and RV; its task codes (e.g. PW.5.1) become gate criteria.
A list of information security controls; each sub-step is mapped to its controls (e.g. A.8.28).
Analysing source code without running it; done by Semgrep.
Checking for vulnerable dependencies and leaked secrets; done by Trivy.
A way to model threats: spoofing, tampering, repudiation, information disclosure, denial of service, elevation of privilege.
The ten most common web application security risks; reviewed in the Testing gate.
Bring Your Own Key: using your own AI provider API key.
Every security requirement (REQ-SEC-…) can be traced to its recommendation, code file, NIST task and ISO control.
